name: no_filter_default_limit
python_query: SELECT reviewer, author, reviews_count, day, toString(repo_id) AS repo_id FROM ( SELECT repo_id, reviewer, author, day, argMax(reviews_count, computed_at) AS reviews_count FROM review_edges_daily WHERE org_id = {org_id:String} AND day >= {since_date:Date} AND day <= {until_date:Date} GROUP BY repo_id, reviewer, author, day ) ORDER BY reviews_count DESC, repo_id, reviewer, author, day LIMIT 500

name: repo_filter
python_query: SELECT reviewer, author, reviews_count, day, toString(repo_id) AS repo_id FROM ( SELECT repo_id, reviewer, author, day, argMax(reviews_count, computed_at) AS reviews_count FROM review_edges_daily WHERE org_id = {org_id:String} AND day >= {since_date:Date} AND day <= {until_date:Date} AND repo_id IN ( SELECT id FROM repos WHERE org_id = {org_id:String} AND (repo IN {repo_ids:Array(String)} OR toString(id) IN {repo_ids:Array(String)}) ) GROUP BY repo_id, reviewer, author, day ) ORDER BY reviews_count DESC, repo_id, reviewer, author, day LIMIT 10
